name: kariricode/configurator
description: Configuration management for KaririCode Framework — multi-format loading, environment interpolation, value processor chains, encrypted secrets, schema validation, hot reload, and ARFA 1.3 ecosystem integration with zero third-party dependencies

suggest.ext-openssl: Required to decrypt ENC(...) values (EncryptedValueProcessor, AES-256-GCM)
suggest.psr/event-dispatcher: Required by EventDispatcherBridge and ReloadableConfiguration events (any PSR-14 dispatcher)
suggest.kariricode/cache: PSR-16 implementation from the KaririCode ecosystem (for CacheBridge)
suggest.kariricode/event-dispatcher: PSR-14 implementation from the KaririCode ecosystem (for lifecycle events)
suggest.kariricode/processor-pipeline: For running ConfigurationProcessor inside processing pipelines
